_meta.topology: Soul on KAIA SoulCoreOS; body (Unreal) on Shadow host house-victoria
_meta.secrets: Do not put API tokens or keys in this file. Use /etc/soulcore/soulcore.env (see env.SoulCoreOS.example).

Host._note: SEC-004 — V1 refuses non-loopback. Desktop / Tailscale clients reach Host via loopback or a local reverse-proxy on the same machine, not a LAN bind.

Memory._note: Empty → platform default under LocalApplicationData. On SoulCoreOS prefer an explicit path under the unit ReadWritePaths, e.g. /var/lib/soulcore/soulcore_memory.db via SOULCORE_Memory__DbPath.

Inference._note: Ollama on KAIA loopback. For 16GB VRAM + 64k ctx, set Ollama process env OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 and OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 (on the ollama.service / Containerfile — not SOULCORE_*). Override model with SOULCORE_Inference__Model.

Hermes._note: Optional. Chat needs SOULCORE_HERMES_API_KEY in EnvironmentFile when Enabled=true.

ChatWs._note: Clients: ws://127.0.0.1:7700/ws. Companion token: SOULCORE_COMPANION_API_TOKEN (≥32 chars) when exposing beyond local desktop.

UnrealBridge._note: Shadow Unreal body host DNS name house-victoria:8888. Host must not crash if UE unreachable (unreal.connected=false in /health). Override with SOULCORE_UnrealBridge__WsUrl / __ConnectTimeoutSeconds.

SoulLoop._note: KILL SWITCH default false for OS image. Enable only when intentional.
